message: <input type="checkbox" name="c"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
checked="true" follows the house style; no change needed. (HTML itself allows only checked="" or checked="checked"; browsers treat any value as on.)
